description_en: If you no longer need an Elastic Accelerated Computing Instance (EAIS), you can call the DeleteEaisEi operation to release the instance
description_zh: 如果您不再需要使用弹性加速计算实例EAIS，您可以调用API DeleteEaisEi释放该EAIS实例
kebab_example: aliyun eais delete-eais-ei --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ei-instance-id eais-hzu00xufs1c8j5nn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteEaisEi

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EAIS instance
parameters.name: ei_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcefully delete the instance if its status does not meet the deletion criteria. Valid values:

true: Force deletes the instance.

false: Does not force delete the instance.

Default value: false.

The relationship between the instance status and this parameter is as follows:

If the instance is in the Attachable state, you do not need to set this parameter. The instance is released normally.

If the instance is not in the Attachable state, set this parameter to true to force release the instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态不符合删除条件时，是否强制删除。取值范围：
true：强制删除。
false：不强制删除。

默认值：false。

实例状态与本参数说明如下：

当实例状态为可绑定时，无需设置本参数，实例会正常释放。
当实例不是可绑定状态时，可以设置本参数值为true来强制释放实例
parameters.name: force
